attribution: Photo: Андрей Романенко, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NATO_Victims_Square,_Murino,_Montenegro.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

author: Wolfgang Sauber
attribution: Photo: Wolfgang Sauber, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Budva_Stari_Grad_-_Ladenschilder_2.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted wooden bakery signs in Budva old town: Russian and English arrow boards above the main Montenegrin board with the owner's name. In 'СПАСОЈе' the final е is painted in lowercase form; Serbian/Montenegrin Ј and Ћ present. Distractors: 'Monte negro art SUVENIRI', 'Blu', 'Boutique Limited', 'OPPOSITE' and other shop signs down the lane.

author: Ramessos
attribution: Photo: Ramessos, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:UlcinjSchilder.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stack of six bilingual Montenegrin/Albanian tourist direction panels in Ulcinj (green, white, blue, brown) with pictograms. Yellow tourist-info board and plates of parked vehicles in the background are distractors.

author: Michal Klajban
attribution: Photo: Michal Klajban, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_for_hikers_in_Crkvice,_Primorska_Planinarska_Transverzala,_Montenegro_152.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted hiking waymark on limestone (white letters, red outline) on the PPT trail, Orjen: names the village Crkvice and the peak Veliki Kabao, 4 hours. Mixed-case brush lettering ('i' with dots). A faded painted mark at the far left before VELIKI is not legible. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Sign for hikers in Crkvice, Primorska Planinarska Transverzala, Montenegro 152.jpg

author: Michal Klajban
attribution: Photo: Michal Klajban, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Orjen_sedlo_sign,_Primorska_Planinarska_Transverzala,_Montenegro_155.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted hiking waymark on cracked limestone with a red-white trail blaze pointing right; names the Orjen saddle (map name usually 'Orjensko sedlo'). The J is painted with its hook facing right (mirrored-looking); rock cracks cross the letters. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Orjen sedlo sign, Primorska Planinarska Transverzala, Montenegro 155.jpg
